Surprising (to me) Facts About Nagaland

	•  English is widely spoken and well understood. 

	•  The entire state is made up of numerous villages, each with a communal space and a large playground.

	•  Sports, especially football, are taken very seriously and played everywhere.

	•  People have strong civic sense (compared to rest of India)

 •  Every village is neat and  clean & the quality of life is much higher (than I thought)

reels.name: 17936597570988735.mp4
reels.caption:
Mussoorie to Dehradun—was supposed to head to Shimla, but Amazon’s next-day delivery had other plans. 😆📦 Had to restock engine oil and grab some winter clothes, so Dehradun it was!

Riding through mountain roads is always a joy. 

28 states, 8 UTs, 20,000 km—one road, one detour at a time. 🇮🇳 #MussoorieToDehradun #RoadTripIndia#cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 18017567498490448.mp4
reels.caption:
Triund Trek ❄️🏔️

Hiked up to Triund, camped at -5°C, and woke up to some insane mountain views. Met an awesome bunch of people along the way, and had a local ‘guide dog’ leading us to the top. 🐕⛰️

Riding across India is amazing, but sometimes you gotta park the bike and hit the trails. ;)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—on foot this time. 🇮🇳 #TriundTrek #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 18030325829319063.mp4
reels.caption:
Shimla to Dharamshala—mountain roads, sheer cliffs, never-ending construction, and a couple of chai breaks. ☕🏍️

Views made up for the riding challenges. Dodging roadwork, and stopping for tea with a view 🏔️

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—every road has a story. 🇮🇳 #ShimlaToDharamshala #MountainRoads #TeaBreaksAndTwisties #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—keeping the ride smooth, one fix at a time. 🇮🇳 #Shimla #ServiceDay

reels.name: 18061719232784382.mp4
reels.caption:
New Delhi - Rishikesh
This place is full of energy, and it’s amazing to see so many travelers from around the world drawn here. 🌏🙏

It’s surprising to see so many Europeans meditating and chanting in a place that feels so distant and tucked away. Guess Rishikesh is more famous outside India than it is among Indians!

reels.name: 17858781876329930.mp4
reels.caption:
Lucknow - Varanasi 

The moment you enter Varanasi, it hits you—the colors, the smells, the sheer vibrance of the city. There’s nowhere else like it. From the chaotic streets to the calm of the Ganga, every corner has a vibe.

The Ganga Aarti at night is surreal. This is a city where life, death, and everything in between can be captured in a single frame.

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—some places don’t just exist, they overwhelm your senses. 🇮🇳 #LucknowToVaranasi #CulturalCapital #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17887963674123683.mp4
reels.caption:
Uttar Pradesh has some of the best road infrastructure—cruised at 180 for long stretches and covered the most distance in the least time. But yeah… running without proper chain lube is gonna catch up with me real soon. 😅

& Having local friends to show you around is the best! Huge thanks to @abh_hba_1 for making Lucknow even more special!

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—fast roads, good company, & endless memories. 🇮🇳 #GwaliorToLucknow #UPRoads #ShouldLubeChainRegularly #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17938731296864712.mp4
reels.caption:
Delhi - Gwalior. 

Stopping at dhabas isn’t just about the food; it’s also about the people you meet. Every stop, every chat—it’s crazy how much you get to learn everyday!

Gwalior Fort was beyond stunning, & the light show brought its history to life. Sat there with a bunch of people from all over India—north, south, east, west—all of us just taking it in. :)

#delhi #gwalior #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17978878520681739.mp4
reels.caption:
Lost a few screws on the way (including my number plate ones), but nothing a couple of zip ties couldn’t fix—best temporary fix till the next workshop!

Back in Delhi for the second time on this trip, getting the final prep done for Nepal. 

This city is something else—chaotic, busy, but still has its own kind of elegance. ✨🏙️

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—one fix, one ride at a time. 🇮🇳 #KurukshetraToDelhi #ZipTieFixes #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 18053534048328652.mp4
reels.caption:
There’s this unique calmness to Brahma Sarovar,—felt like time slowed down for a bit. 

Watching sunrises and sunsets day after day for four months straight. No rush, no deadlines, just the open road and the changing sky. :)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km - chasing the sun. 🇮🇳 #ChandigarhToRishikesh #BrahmaSarovar #SunriseToSunset #thegreatindiaride #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt

reels.name: 18058113686316949.mp4
reels.caption:
From roadside chats with the elders to laughing with kids, every stop turns into a conversation. & that’s the beauty of the road—it connects you with people from all walks of life. 🤝✨

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—every ride, a new story. 🇮🇳 #AmritsarToChandigarh #ConversationsOnTheRoad #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 18066199942922668.mp4
reels.caption:
J&K to Amritsar—green fields, open roads, and the kindest people 🌾

Stopped a few times along the way, and every single time, someone invited me for chai. By the time I reached Amritsar, I had tea with four different people—just because that’s how warm and welcoming Punjabis are. ☕🤝

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—this is about the people as much as the places. 🇮🇳 #JammuToAmritsar #PunjabiHospitality #TeaAtEveryStop #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17854715319409946.mp4
reels.caption:
Varanasi to Lumbini—crossing into Nepal :)

From the birthplace of Buddha to monasteries built by countries around the world, Lumbini is a reminder of how far his teachings have traveled.

& absolutely magical night sky - No city lights(which is a stark contrast to India)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—now in Nepal #VaranasiToLumbini #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17926052747938753.mp4
reels.caption:
probably the roughest stretch yet.

Some roads were just… not there. 😅 Riding through dust, rocks, and chaos, with the chain starting to complain halfway through—clogged up with all the dirt and debris.

But the landscape was absolutely stunning!

The border areas of Nepal feel a lot like India, but places like Pokhara and Kathmandu—they’ve got their own unique vibe and charm :)

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—and Nepal, you’ve been wild and beautiful. 🇳🇵 #KathmanduToJanakpur #NoRoadsNoProblem #DustyButBeautiful #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 17980094927683502.mp4
reels.caption:
Twisties, landslides, dust, traffic— name it, this stretch had it. Took way longer than expected and felt like I was in an off-road rally at times 😅

But reaching Kathmandu felt like a reward in itself. Bustling city, unique vibe, and that feeling of making it through a tough ride. Nepal keeps testing, but it also keeps giving. 🇳🇵

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—every tough day leads to a great destination. #PokharaToKathmandu #MountainChaos #MadeItToKathmandu #thegreatindiaride #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride

reels.name: 18269826001256432.mp4
reels.caption:
Lumbini to Pokhara—stunning views and some seriously rough roads!

Got lucky with some riding company in Nepal. But I definitely underestimated the road conditions here—tough on both me and the bike. 

By the time I reached Pokhara, I was completely drained.🥲

Still, the views made it all worth it :) Nepal is something else. 🇳🇵

28 states, 6 UTs, 20,000 km—some roads test you, but the journey is always worth it. #RoughRoadsGreatViews #cfmoto #cfmotoindia #cfmotoofficial #cfmoto650mt #thegreatindiaride
